answer: Bindings are kept in opal, verified in plume, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the juniper check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 2207 identities would post 3165 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
